subject: You might be Surprised!
author: ZombieTron
body:
A lot of us thought we would stop playing Revenge when Paradise came out. But as they are such different games, we are still playing Revenge!

NFS:HP will not replace Revenge.

I am looking forward to it, but I am sure I will still come back to Revenge for my Burnout fix! 🙂

subject: It is slowly dying but will stay alive for a while.
author: Kiwiharser
body:
I bought this game used around 2-3 months ago to play in my holiday. I've been playing this game almost every single day since then and it's still great.

I do notice a difference in the amount of people playing. Alot of people picked up Blur and or Split second and only a few remain on revenge.  Very often I can only find a crash lobby and i have to wait for a while untill a race/road rage lobby appears again. 
The weird thing is that some days i can actually scroll down in the list of lobbies and the next day there is only 1.

There are 2-3 groups of friends who still play almost every single day and if u add some of these guys you always have someone to play with.

Revenge will live for a while but i don't think it can survive after  Criterion's NFS is released.

subject: Less people playing, but still a laugh!
author: ZombieTron
body:
The last couple of days when I have jumped on there haven't been many rooms open. But, I still manage to find somewhere to have a laugh.... mostly in unranked!

I hosted my own unranked game a few nights ago, and we ended up doing some Crash Party. I am not a natural born crasher, but it was really nice to have a change of pace. Last night there was a Crash Room in Ranked and a Road Rage room in Unranked, so I jumped into the Road Rage. That is another mode I very rarely play on Burnout Revenge.

I was instantly invited to a chat party and it was a bunch of noobs who seemed to know each other in real life... I didn't say much, but I enjoyed listening to a few kids enjoying the game in a fresh way.

I will be very sad if I go online a few times and nobody is playing... I don't think that will happen for a little while yet tho, especially if new racers are encouraged to continue by the old guard. 🙂

Why not Adopt a Noob today!! 👍

subject: Not gonna happen :(
author: ZombieTron
body:
Burnout Revenge was originally an Xbox game, it was then re-made in HD for the 360 with a handful of new DLC cars. Sadly Criterion Games didn't continue to support Revenge after release on the 360 and moved on to create Burnout Paradise.

Burnout Paradise always had DLC planned, that too has now come to an end and the team have moved on to NFS:HP.

None of the Tournaments were organised officially by Critierion Games, they were all community run. As the community is smaller now, it is harder to organise events like those we used to have quite regularly.

I am very happy that we are still able to play Revenge online, EA could sunset the servers at any time! So, although we wont see any new tracks, at least we can still play... for now! 🕐
